Minors: under-16 may work 7-9 p.m. on a night before a non-school day with parental approval (R.C. 4109.07(A)(4), as amended eff. 2026-10-09); encoded latest_end = 7 p.m. (strict).

Minors: 16-17 school-day earliest start encoded as 7 a.m. (6 a.m. allowed if not employed after 8 p.m. the previous night); 11 p.m. latest end applies only before a school day but is enforced every day of a school week (stricter). No Ohio hour limits for 16-17 when school is out.
Minors: a minor may not work more than 5 consecutive hours without a 30-minute rest period (R.C. 4109.07(C)); not encoded (no minor-break rule type).
